title: Build a Responsive Student Dashboard with HTML, CSS & Bootstrap
description: Create a responsive dashboard layout using CSS Grid, Flexbox, CSS variables, and Bootstrap 5 components
objective: Students will build a responsive student dashboard page from scratch using CSS Grid for layout, Flexbox for alignment, CSS variables for theming, and Bootstrap 5 for UI components

steps.title: Create the Project Structure and Base HTML
steps.instructions:
Create a new folder for your project: ``` student-dashboard/ ├── index.html ├── css/ │ └── style.css └── js/ └── app.js ``` Create `index.html` with the base structure: ```html TechPath Institute — Student Dashboard
TechPath Institute
  • Dashboard
  • Students
  • Courses
Menu
Dashboard Students Courses Attendance Reports

Dashboard

© 2026 TechPath Institute, Bhopal. All rights reserved.

``` Open with VS Code Live Server (right-click > Open with Live Server) or just double-click the file. You should see the navbar and basic layout.

steps.title: Style the Layout with CSS Grid and Variables
Add Stats Cards and Student Table
Add Bootstrap Modal and Alerts
steps.instructions:
Add a "Add Student" button and modal form to `index.html`. Insert this just before the `
` line: ```html
Add New Student
``` Now add the form handler in `js/app.js` (add at the bottom): ```javascript // Handle Add Student form function setupAddForm() { const form = document.getElementById('addForm'); if (!form) return; form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const formData = new FormData(form); const newStudent = { name: formData.get('name'), email: formData.get('email'), city: formData.get('city'), course: formData.get('course'), marks: parseInt(formData.get('marks')), }; students.push(newStudent); renderStats(); renderTable(students); // Show success alert document.getElementById('alertArea').innerHTML = `
Student "${newStudent.name}" added successfully!
`; // Close modal and reset form bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('addModal')).hide(); form.reset(); }); } ``` Update the DOMContentLoaded function: ```javascript document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { renderStats(); renderTable(students); setupAddForm(); }); ``` Test it: 1. Click "+ Add Student" — the modal should appear 2. Fill in the form and submit 3. The new student should appear in the table 4. A green success alert should appear 5. Stats should update automatically

steps.title: Test Responsive Design and Submit
steps.instructions:
Test your dashboard at different screen sizes using Chrome DevTools:

1. Open Chrome DevTools (F12 or right-click > Inspect)
2. Click the device toolbar icon (or press Ctrl+Shift+M)
3. Test these screen sizes:

| Device | Width | What Should Happen |
|--------|-------|--------------------|
| iPhone SE | 375px | Sidebar hidden, cards stack vertically, table scrolls horizontally |
| iPad | 768px | Sidebar appears, cards in 2 columns |
| Laptop | 1024px | Full layout, cards in 4 columns |
| Desktop | 1440px | Same as laptop, content stays centered |

Check these responsive behaviors:
- [ ] Navbar hamburger menu works on mobile
- [ ] Sidebar hides on mobile, shows on tablet+
- [ ] Stats cards wrap from 4 columns to 2 to 1 as screen shrinks
- [ ] Table has horizontal scroll on small screens (no overflow)
- [ ] Search box is usable on mobile
- [ ] Modal form is usable on mobile
- [ ] Footer stays at the bottom

Also verify:
- [ ] CSS variables are used (change `--primary` color, entire theme should change)
- [ ] Search filtering works in real time
- [ ] Add student modal works and updates the table
- [ ] Pass/Fail badges show correct colors

Take screenshots at mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1024px+) sizes.

**Submit:**
1. Your project folder (index.html + css/style.css + js/app.js)
2. Three screenshots: mobile, tablet, desktop
3. A screenshot of the Add Student modal working
